status: Prepared only. No hosted staff privilege activation is authorized by this file.
approvalScope: One-time activation of existing portal_staff_rollout gate, followed by owner-managed staff invitations through Team & Permissions.
preconditions: Verify deployed portal and Edge commit match the reviewed release
Verify hosted staff gate remains false and review any existing staff identities/grants before activation
Review isolated Operations Administrator and Domain Manager browser evidence, recovery behavior and active-session revocation
Record known unsupported payment/registrar recovery paths and leave them unavailable or owner-escalated
Founder explicitly approves the rollout and the first staff member's role
activation: Capture the gate state and existing grants without exporting credentials
Enable only portal_staff_rollout.enabled in the existing project after explicit approval
Owner verifies fresh MFA, opens Team & Permissions and enters the approved employee name/email
Use Domain Manager for client/domain handoffs only, or Operations Administrator only for approved broader duties
Employee sets their own password, verifies their email and enrolls their own authenticator
Verify the employee can use only their assigned role before relying on the account for daily work
rollback: Owner can suspend an individual employee through Team & Permissions with fresh MFA
For a rollout-wide incident, set the existing gate false. Owner access is preserved and staff API permissions are denied
Authorization rejection clears the affected workspace on the next request, with independent cross-tab session invalidation
Preserve identities, customer records, assignments and immutable audit history. Do not delete records to revoke access
separateApprovals: Company-domain nameserver delegation after the DNS gate review
Worker application cutover after delegation and website/email checks
limits: The isolated browser exercise uses one disposable staff identity whose role is changed through the owner UI. It is not a hosted employee rollout, a multi-employee load test or approval to execute live renewals. Uncertain provider actions must be escalated rather than guessed or replayed.
